subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The approach or style of teaching
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pedagogy"** refers to the method and practice of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept. (शिक्षण शास्त्र)

 
 
• **Example: **The university offers courses in** pedagogy** to help future educators refine their teaching skills.
 
 
 
• **"Teaching"** is the act of imparting knowledge or instructing someone on how to do something. (शिक्षण)
 
 
• **Example: **She has been** teaching **mathematics at the high school for over a decade.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **the approach or style of teaching is best described by the term** **'Pedagogy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pedagogy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Media **(मीडिया): The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the internet).

 
 
• **Example:** Social media platforms have revolutionized the way we communicate.
 
 
 
• **Philology **(भाषाशास्त्र ): The study of language in written historical sources; it is a combination of literary studies, history, and linguistics.
 
 
• **Example: **She studied philology to understand the evolution of ancient texts.
 
 
 
• **Platform** (मंच): A raised level surface on which people or things can stand.
 
 
• **Example:** The speaker stood on the platform to address the crowd.
